STATUS: PARTIAL RESULT: Source identity verified. HEAD = `79c291a40684869facb160a20341ba7340d96b04`, branch `claude/theme-recommendation-reasons-20260921-sol`, `git status --porcelain` empty (clean). PICKUP_ACK and START were performed at the start of this review; no worker, subagent, network fetch, git write or source edit was performed. Core logic is sound: the recommendation-verb refactor is behavior-preserving, and the stock-admission refactor is eligibility-identical. But the packet cannot be PASSed: the new material UI component's **opened** state is evidenced in only 2 of 8 theme × language × viewport combinations, which is incomplete dual-theme evidence under the Theme art-direction law — that alone forces PARTIAL. Findings below. EVIDENCE: Verified-clean claims (falsification attempts failed): - `engine/theme_scoring.py:874-916` — `_reco_decision` is verb-equivalent to the removed `_reco`. Dominant branch reorder (`extended` → crowding → macro) and emerging branch (`macro` → `crowd`) preserve conjunction semantics including NaN (`not crowd_pen < 0.6` is True for NaN, matching the old `crowd_pen < 0.6` False → hold). - `engine/theme_scoring.py:1244-1271` — `regime_demoted`/`chase_demoted` are each set only when the verb was actually demoted to `hold`, and are mutually exclusive, so the `elif` chain at `theme_scoring.py:1289-1296` (`_recommendation_explanation`) cannot mis-attribute. - `engine/basket_score.py:340-384` (`_stock_entry_check`) vs the removed inline gates: eligibility is identical to the old `buys` admission for both the `status` path and the legacy `verdict`/`entry_pct>=0.45` path. Legacy stock behavior is preserved for admission. - `basket_score.py:418-424` — `qualified`/`unavailable`/`waiting` are arithmetically consistent, and `unavailable` is the same population as the pre-existing `uncovered` (`basket_score.py:464-465`). - XSS: `templates/basket_detail.html.j2:1228` `stk()` escapes the symbol; reason strings go through `esc()` at the new `stockEntryChecksHtml` row map. No unescaped payload sink found in the added code. - Compiled artifact integrity: all 121 records in `publication_20260923/native-refresh-receipt.json` were re-hashed against the committed files — **0 missing, 0 mismatches**. Aggregates reproduce the claims: 121 pages, `members` sum = **1,917**, regions us49/china22/hk17/intl17/canada16, `as_of` us+canada 2026-09-21 / china+hk+intl 2026-09-22, `admission_unchanged` true on all 121, `qualified` sum = 6. Findings: 1. **MAJOR — dual-theme/EN-ZH evidence for the new component is 2/8 cells.** `publication_20260923/interactions/` contains only `{0..4}-light-en-1440.png` and `{0..4}-dark-zh-390.png` (`results.json` records confirm `theme/lang/width` = light/en/1440 and dark/zh/390 only). The new `
` is closed by default, so the 40-cell canonical capture (`capture/manifest.json` `totals.states_captured=40`, axes dark+light × en+zh × 1440/390) never shows the new table body. Consequence: **light-ZH and dark-EN renderings of the new component are entirely unevidenced**, light is evidenced only at 1440 and dark only at 390 — so neither theme is adjudicable as a design across the responsive composition axis. Per house law this is PARTIAL/BLOCKED, never PASS. 2. **MAJOR — no light art direction is stated for the new surface.** `recommendation_reasons_20260921/README.md:61-67` asserts only that existing dark/light material is "retained". It names no DARK TREATMENT / LIGHT TREATMENT for the newly introduced disclosure + table + action link, no mechanisms that intentionally differ, and no theme-specific degraded states (e.g. the `

"Stock entry reasons are unavailable."

` validation-failure state, which appears in zero capture). 3. **MINOR — on-page self-contradiction about relative strength.** The contested line was rewritten to `'relative strength high within its recent history; not an own-price extension measure'` and `rolloverReasonText` rewrites `extended (RS N%ile)` → `high relative strength`, but `timingCardsHtml` (`templates/basket_detail.html.j2`, `card('rollover_risk', … reasons(rr.reasons, rr.reasons_zh))`) is untouched and still renders the raw producer string `"extended (RS 87%ile)"` (emitted at `engine/basket_score.py:275`), whose built-in ZH fallback in the same file reads `涨幅偏高（相对强弱第N百分位）` — i.e. "price gain is high", exactly the extension reading the change set out to deny. Both strings render on the same page. 4. **MINOR — new mixed-language string in ZH.** `rolloverReasonText(rr.reasons, true)` translates only the one regex-matched reason and passes every other **English** reason through into the Chinese sentence (`rollover_risk` has no `reasons_zh`; see `basket_score.py:311-314`). Previously the ZH string was uniformly English; it is now EN/ZH mixed. EN/ZH parity regression, small but new. 5. **MINOR — summary counts contradict the row reasons under a blocked theme.** `_stock_entry_check` tests `theme_blocked` **first** (`basket_score.py:351-352`), so every row reads "Theme risk blocks new stock entries", while `entry_summary.unavailable` (computed from `score is None`, `basket_score.py:419`) still reports N unavailable. The rendered chip therefore prints "0 qualified · X waiting · Y unavailable" with no row explaining any unavailability. 6. **MINOR — dead anchor when the payload fails validation.** The "Check individual stocks →" link is emitted whenever `d.act_now.entry_checks` is a non-empty array, but `stockEntryChecksHtml` returns a `

` with **no** `id="stock-entry-checks"` on validation failure; the click handler's `if(detail)` guard then falls through to default navigation to a non-existent fragment. 7. **NIT — unreachable "missing data" reason codes.** `reason_unavailable` for macro/crowding (`theme_scoring.py:895-906`) cannot fire in production: `macro_g` is coerced to `0.0` when macro is None (`theme_scoring.py:1226`) and `_crowding_pen` returns `float(np.clip(pen,0,1))`, always finite. 8. **NIT — `entry.headline`/`headline_zh` no longer drive watch blocker text** (`basket_score.py:441-445`); the producer's own per-stock headline is replaced by a generic status map. The fields are still emitted on the record, so this is a copy-specificity loss, not data loss. GAPS: - Light-ZH and dark-EN renderings of the opened stock-entry disclosure: not captured, not reviewed. - Light at 390 and dark at 1440 for the same component: not captured. - The validation-failure and `allUnknown` header states: not captured in any theme. - I did not complete byte-level verification of the whole-page `DETAIL` JSON field-by-field preservation (status/buy/coverage/date) beyond the receipt's own `status_buys_coverage_preserved: true` flag and the 121-file hash match; the receipt's self-attestation is not independent proof of per-field preservation. The `?v=` stylesheet line diff on `site/basket/ai_semiconductors.html` was mid-inspection at the cap and is unresolved. - Investigation cap reached; no tests were executed, so no claim here rests on a test run. DEVIATIONS: - No source edit, git write, PR action, deploy, network fetch, subagent or watcher. Read-only throughout. - Hosted CI 35822767847 and fences green were noted but are explicitly **not** part of this verdict; no production acceptance is inferred. `#7769` and `#7749` were not reviewed. - Report returned under the 24-turn cap; items in GAPS are unperformed coverage, not adverse findings.
